test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: On a sum of money for 2 years compound interest and simple interest are Rs. 550 and Rs. 500. Find the rate of interest (in per annum).
solution: Given: Compound interest = Rs. 550 Simple interest = Rs. 500 Time = 2 years Formula used: CI – SI = SI × R/200 Also, CI – SI = PR²/100² Where R = rate %
